headline: Revenue accelerates, guidance raised amid CFO transition
summary_short: Adobe's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 12.7% y/y to a record $6.62 billion, with GAAP diluted EPS of $4.25 (+7.9% y/y) despite a $0.17/share non-cash goodwill impairment, and the company raised its full-year FY2026 revenue and non-GAAP EPS targets.
summary_long: Record Q2 revenue of $6.62B rose 13% y/y (11% constant currency) on AI-driven demand across customer groups: Business Professionals & Consumers grew 16% y/y to $1.85B and Creative & Marketing Professionals grew 13% y/y to $4.54B. Total ARR reached $27.10B, including about $480M from Semrush. GAAP operating income was $2.24B and diluted EPS $4.25, including a $0.17/share non-cash goodwill impairment and a $0.07/share litigation loss contingency. Adobe repurchased $2.11B of stock and held $4.92B cash at quarter-end. The company raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $26.50B-$26.60B and non-GAAP EPS guidance to $24.35-$24.45, and guided Q3 revenue to $6.67B-$6.72B. CFO Dan Durn departs June 15; Steve Day becomes interim CFO.
